title: Reasons you should stay natural: you will become physically dependent on PEDs
summary: Argues against the 'just do one cycle' mindset: exogenous hormones shut down natural production, which may take months or never recover; muscle gained on cycle is mostly lost once off; and having tasted the 'superhero' state, users go back on, cycle repeatedly, and end up on permanent blast-and-cruise that destroys their health. He accuses ex-users claiming tiny doses of lying, and urges patience and natural training.

claims.claim: The number one goal of his channel is to discourage young people from taking PEDs and to show how to do it the right way.
He has not used PEDs himself; his view comes from knowing many users and their testimonies.
Introducing exogenous hormones like testosterone makes the body stop producing its own, and it doesn't pick up the slack when you stop; you need a PCT to restart production.
Natural hormone production doesn't reliably return in three weeks or two months: for some it takes six or eight months, for some it never restarts, and you can't know beforehand.
After a cycle you lose most of the muscle gained because the hormonal environment it grew in no longer exists.
Dependency comes from having experienced the higher hormonal state's strength, size and pump; going from 'superhero' back to normal drives users back onto PEDs, even without drug-like cravings.
Repeated on-off cycling eventually leaves natural hormone production unable to restart, forcing permanent blast-and-cruise.
Exogenous hormones are dangerous by default because they are artificial, even at a replacement dose; at typical doses used constantly they destroy the body.
PED users end up either ruined, with the body they built gone, or forced to come off because the alternative is death.
YouTubers who say they used drugs in the past but now take only a small dose are lying; they still take far too much.
Learn from honest ex-users' mistakes rather than ruining your own health to learn the lesson; that is wisdom.
You can gain amazing amounts of muscle naturally, but you must be patient and consistent: you won't blow up in two months, but you'll live beyond your 50s.
